questions.q: A window is [1, 2, 3] and the rebuilt window is [1, 2, 5]. What is the mean squared reconstruction error?
questions.why: Differences are 0, 0, −2. Squares are 0, 0, 4. The mean is 4 / 3 = 1.333.
